headword: {消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}

definitions.gloss: firefighter; member of a firefighting unit
definitions.explanation: A professional member of a fire brigade whose job is to put out fires and carry out rescues. Formed from {消防|しょうぼう} (firefighting) and {隊員|たいいん} (unit member).

examples.japanese: {消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}が{現場|げんば}に{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: The firefighters arrived at the scene.

examples.japanese: {消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}が{煙|けむり}の{中|なか}から{人|ひと}を{救|すく}い{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The firefighter pulled a person out of the smoke.

examples.japanese: {火事|かじ}の{通報|つうほう}を{受|う}けて、{消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}たちがすぐに{出動|しゅつどう}した。
examples.english: After receiving the fire report, the firefighters were dispatched at once.

notes:
A paid professional attached to a {消防署|しょうぼうしょ} (fire station), as opposed to a volunteer in a {消防団|しょうぼうだん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}が{出動|しゅつどう}する: the firefighters are dispatched
- {消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}になる: to become a firefighter
- {勇敢|ゆうかん}な{消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}: a brave firefighter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {消防士|しょうぼうし}: firefighter — the more common everyday term for the occupation.
- {消防団|しょうぼうだん}: volunteer fire corps — community volunteers, not full-time staff.
